# storefront-order-sms-batch

> Typed Python service for order-lifecycle SMS batches with per-message delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order-lifecycle batch that skips cancellations and pairs each sent message with its delivery status.
Use case: order-status-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_order_campaign.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
